about: the VS title card with the kit configs' opt-ins (TITLE_LINES, TITLE_BALLS, MIDDLE): every frame on which title.draw(noise, frame / 30) draws, pinned by the SHA-256 of its (640, 360, 3) uint8 bytes

cases.why: the same card with TITLE_BALLS as floats: the same bytes
MIDDLE with an angle in degrees (a variant of the rematch, not a kit config)
MIDDLE at 0 degrees: Python's falsy angle takes the upright paths (a variant)

middle_error.error: MIDDLE 'THE ULTIMATE GRAND FINAL REMATCH' does not fit the diagonal

note: Each case is a kit config (or a named variant) as `why` says, drawn in its own process with the stand-ins listed. words: title.WORDS by role (A, VS, B), floats as float.hex(); balls: title.BALLS. title_balls_python: the Python types of the config's TITLE_BALLS values. The _floats case is the bass clarinet example with every TITLE_BALLS value a float; its hashes equal the int case's. drawn: per frame, the count of reelkit.ui.DRAWN boxes and the SHA-256 of their lines "x0,y0,x1,y1,kind,info" (each ending in a newline); cover: one frame's boxes in full.
standin: standin_closeup(k)(r): n = 2 r + 7; c = n // 2; inside = ((x - c)^2 + (y - c)^2) * 10 <= 9 r r; rgb = ((x * 7 + 40 k) % 256, (y * 5 + 90) % 256, ((x + y) * 3 + 20 k) % 256) inside, else 0; alpha 255 inside. The stood-in fighters' PATTERNS entries are removed (plain panels).
